source:
flowchart LR
    subgraph ingest [Incoming requests and validation from external systems]
        Request([Receive a request with a long descriptive title])
        Validate{All required fields and permissions valid?}
        Request --> Validate
    end
    subgraph processing [Order processing and downstream integrations]
        Reserve(Reserve inventory across multiple warehouses)
        Charge(Authorize the customer's payment method)
        Store[(Persist the order and its audit history)]
        Reserve -->|Inventory reserved successfully| Charge
        Charge --> Store
    end
    Validate -->|Validated request ready for processing| Reserve
    Validate -->|Missing or invalid fields| Reject(Explain what needs to change)
    Charge -->|Payment declined; retry with updated details| Request
    Store --> Notify(Send a confirmation to the customer)
    Store -->|Publish a durable event| Notify
    Store --> Store
    Observer[An independent monitoring service]
    classDef default fill:#EEF2FF,stroke:#A5B4FC,color:#312E81
    classDef error fill:#FFF1F2,stroke:#FDA4AF,color:#9F1239
    class Reject error
